format.description: 'text' (default) for Markdown, 'json' for a structured response

maturity.description: New $plugin->maturity constant: MATURITY_ALPHA, MATURITY_BETA, MATURITY_RC or MATURITY_STABLE (default: unchanged)

plugin.description: Component (e.g. 'local_myplugin'), path relative to the Moodle root (e.g. 'local/myplugin'), or absolute path

upgrade_description.description: One-line description written as a comment in the generated upgrade step

upgrade_step.description: Also add an upgrade step for the new version to db/upgrade.php, creating the file when missing (default: false)

version.description: New $plugin->version, ten digits (YYYYMMDDXX) greater than the current one (default: today as YYYYMMDD00, or the current version + 1 when that is not greater)

files_changed.description: Files written, relative to the plugin directory

maturity.description: $plugin->maturity written by the call, when one was given

path.description: Plugin directory relative to the Moodle root

release.description: $plugin->release written by the call, when one was given

upgrade_file_created.description: Whether db/upgrade.php did not exist and was created

upgrade_step.description: PHP code of the upgrade step added to db/upgrade.php
